name: vllm_apply_repetition_penalties_cuda
description: Faithfully extracted from KernelGenBench test_apply_repetition_penalties_cuda.py. In-place repetition penalty mutation on logits; masks are bool, penalties float32. Reference calls vLLM _custom_ops.apply_repetition_penalties_cuda (mutates logits) and returns the mutated tensor. Workloads use dtype=float32, penalties=1.1 (from test constant). Requires vLLM at eval time.
